d:
A collection of shitajiki for OjaHoi! 1-5, a series of Ojamajo Doremi doujin events held from 2003-2007.

OjaHoi! 1 drawn by Moe Moe Cafe
OjaHoi! 2 drawn by Shitto
OjaHoi! 3 drawn by T-Hiko
OjaHoi! 4 drawn by KONKON
OjaHoi! 5 drawn by Nama Banana

https://web.archive.org/web/20030621115054/http://ojamajo.parfait.ne.jp/ojahoi/

RAW TIFFs and 1200DPI JPGs: https://archive.org/details/ojahoi
